why:
Checks 1–3 hold. Check 1 passes on `HELLO, ADA!`, which is the upper case of the greeting. Check 2 asks for exactly `Hello, Ada!\n`, which is today's output, so that is what "unchanged" means. Check 3 asks for a mention of `--shout` plus a description of what it does, which "documents" reasonably covers. The extras (npm test, flag after the name, exit status) sit under Advisory.

Check 4 breaks the criterion. Its PASS condition requires the workflow to publish docs/ in one particular way: "(upload-pages-artifact with path docs, then deploy-pages)". The expect line only says the published page lists `--shout` after merge. It doesn't name these actions or say how Pages gets deployed. A head that publishes docs/ with a different deploy action would still meet the expect line but fail this PASS condition. That is a structural rule stricter than the words, and it belongs under Advisory.
